title: Goal line prints "about 1 years" when a goal takes 26-27 paychecks
detail: `mo<12 ? ... : \`about ${Math.round(mo/12*10)/10} years\`` -- for n=26 paychecks mo is exactly 12, so the branch yields 'about 1 years'; n=27 also rounds to 1. Ran fmtMonths over 1..52: 25 -> 'about 12 months', 26 -> 'about 1 years', 27 -> 'about 1 years', 52 -> 'about 2 years'. Twenty-six paychecks is exactly one year on this app's own 26-per-year model (yearNet = periodNet*26), so a goal sized to a year's take-home hits this case precisely.
failure: A nurse with a goal equal to roughly a year of take-home sees 'Emergency fund: 26 paychecks (about 1 years)' under the money card.
fix: Special-case the singular: `const y=Math.round(mo/12*10)/10; return \`about ${y} year${y===1?'':'s'}\``.
